info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Intellectual Property Portfolio API
info.description: This API facilitates the maintenance and enhancement of an organization's intellectual property portfolio. Users can update information related to various knowledge assets, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records. Typical consumers of this API include legal teams, intellectual property managers, and innovation departments who need to track and manage their intellectual property efficiently. By leveraging this functionality, businesses can streamline their asset management processes and protect their innovations more effectively.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific intellectual property portfolio identified by its resource ID. Ensure that you provide the correct fields to be updated in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific intellectual property portfolio identified by its resource ID RES-100045.
